text:
What is an electric field?
A
a region around a wire carrying an electric current in which a compass needle experiences a
force
B
a region in which an electric charge experiences a force
C
a region in which an electric charge is attracted by the Earth’s gravity
D
a region through which electromagnetic radiation is passing
